title: The Nihilist Reading Of Platinum End #Shorts
description:
The feeling that Platinum End means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. Platinum End (Japanese: プラチナエンド, Hepburn: Purachina Endo) is a Japanese manga series written by Tsugumi Ohba and illustrated by Takeshi Obata. It was serialized in Shueisha's monthly shōnen manga magazine Jump Square from November 2015 to January 2021, with its chapters collected in 14 tankōbon volumes.

What culture calls destiny in Platinum End is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. In March 2016, Viz confirmed that they would start releasing print editions of Platinum End, with the first volume released in October 2016. On December 2, 2020, Pony Canyon registered the "Anime-PlatinumEnd.com" domain name, and on December 19, 2020, at the Jump Festa '21 online event, it was announced that the manga would receive an anime television series adaptation by Signal.MD.
